slimpatch.configuration.restart_notice: Changes require a Minecraft restart to fully apply.
slimpatch.configuration.allowMultiplayer: Allows villagers to use uploaded custom PNG skins in multiplayer and LAN worlds.
slimpatch.configuration.maxCustomSkinSiz: Maximum uploaded custom skin size in kilobytes for multiplayer and LAN uploads.

slimpatch.config.customIllagerSkins.tool: Enables custom models for all illagers: Evokers, Pillagers, and Vindicators.
slimpatch.config.customPillagerModel.too: Enables the custom model for Pillagers when custom illager models are enabled.
slimpatch.config.customVindicatorModel.t: Enables the custom model for Vindicators when custom illager models are enabled.
slimpatch.config.customEvokerModel.toolt: Enables the custom model for Evokers when custom illager models are enabled.
slimpatch.config.customIllagerSounds.too: Enables the custom sounds for Evokers, Pillagers, and Vindicators.
slimpatch.config.customWitchSkin.tooltip: Enables the custom model for Witches.
slimpatch.config.customVillagerSounds.to: Enables custom male and female villager sounds.
slimpatch.config.villagerNameTag.tooltip: Enables villager name tags above their heads in the world.
slimpatch.config.pressRToTalkIndicator.t: Enables the on-screen dialogue key prompt when near a villager.
slimpatch.config.dialogueCameraSensitivi: Adjusts the dialogue screen camera edge movement speed.
slimpatch.config.dialogueScreenBlur.tool: Enables blur effect while talking to villagers.
slimpatch.config.forceFirstPersonInDialo: Forces first-person camera while talking to villagers.
slimpatch.config.allowMultiplePlayerSpou: Allows players to be married to more than one villager at the same time.
slimpatch.config.spouseCookingEnabled.to: Allows spouses to occasionally prepare food for the player.
slimpatch.config.spouseCookingCooldownTi: How many ticks must pass before a spouse can prepare food again.
slimpatch.config.healthPerGoldenCarrot.t: Adds this much maximum health each time a villager is fed a golden carrot.
slimpatch.config.maxBonusHealth.tooltip: Caps the total extra maximum health a villager can gain from golden carrots.
slimpatch.cutscene.skip_hint: Press ESC again to skip the cutscene
slimpatch.config.enableWeddingCutscene.t: Enables the wedding cutscene after a successful marriage proposal.
slimpatch.cutscene.family_skip_hint: Press ESC again to skip the family cutscene
slimpatch.config.enableFamilyCutscene.to: Enables the family cutscene after deciding to have a child.
How many ticks a pregnancy lasts for both player-villager and villager-villager families.
slimpatch.config.toddlerDurationTicks.to: How many ticks a toddler takes to grow into a child.
slimpatch.config.childDurationTicks.tool: How many ticks a child takes to grow into a teen.
slimpatch.config.teenDurationTicks.toolt: How many ticks a teen takes to grow into an adult.
slimpatch.config.enableAging.tooltip: Enables natural aging for toddlers, children, and teens.
slimpatch.config.familyCharmMaxChildrenP: Maximum number of children a villager pair can have through Family Charm.
slimpatch.config.enablePregnancyBelly.to: Shows a subtle pregnancy belly on adult female villagers who are expecting.
